extraction_notes: Only thermocatalytic CO2 methanation measurements from this paper were extracted. Dense scatter in the long-term figures was summarized as the printed initial/final stability values and printed aged points; exact tabulated SI data were not included in the provided parse. CO was stated as the only byproduct in several runs, but CO selectivity was not numerically reported, so it was left missing. Total flow was not copied where it would require calculation from WHSV and catalyst mass.
